sentences.en: And our council is the local government for our area.
sentences.zh: 我们这个理事会就是我们地区的当地政府。

sentences.en: An executive council was formed to discuss the new proposal.
sentences.zh: 一个执行委员会成立来讨论新的提案。

sentences.en: We must hold a meeting of the council of directors.
sentences.zh: 我们必须召开董事会议。

senses.zh: 委员会,（郡、镇等）政务会,（尤指旧时讨论特定步骤的）协商会议,市政（或地方管理）服务机构
